notes.title: Introducing Project: Woven!
notes.content:
Hello!

There has been a long silence on my end when it comes to Tophat Quest. In all honesty, I did really enjoy the game I was working on, but there were so many flaws and overall spaghetti code in the entire game... that I felt discouraged to continue to work on it.

But! I have now took the great ideas from Tophat Quest, and further expanded upon them to completely re-code a new game from the ground up, and that is Project: Woven! A platformer and an RPG! :)

More information is on the Store Page itself, I hope you are all as excited for this change as I am!

And something to note... there is no planned release date currently. It's still in development!

Thank you! - Frogman.
